item.title: Cylake Raises $245 Million Ahead of Cybersecurity Platform Beta
item.description: The startup founded by Palo Alto Networks’ Nir Zuk has raised $290 million to build an AI-native security platform for highly regulated organizations that cannot rely on the public cloud. item.description: Affecting the SAP kernel code, the flaw allows unauthenticated, remote attackers to run arbitrary commands, recover secrets, and modify data. The post SAP Patches Critical Extended Passport Processing Vulnerability appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: BitInfinite Wins ECCV 2026 CAD Challenge on Manufacturable STEP BRep Generation
item.description: BitInfinite and Wuhan University took first place in the ECCV 2026 CAD Challenge, scoring 96.39 on Render and TechDraw to STEP BRep generation. The task emphasizes manufacturable physical CAD over visual-only 3D meshes.

item.title: Deemos Hyper3D WorldGen Builds Editable Multi-Asset 3D Scenes From a Single Image
item.description: Deemos has launched Hyper3D WorldGen, which converts one image into editable multi-asset 3D scenes using its SIGGRAPH-awarded CAST research. The tool targets games, film, XR and embodied simulation pipelines including Blender and Unreal Engine.

item.title: Tmall AI Space Station Puts Zhipu, Moonshot and MiniMax Subscriptions on Retail Shelves
item.description: Tmall has launched an AI Space Station selling token and coding subscriptions from Chinese LLM providers as retail-like top-ups. Zhipu AI opened a Coding Plan storefront, while Moonshot AI and MiniMax are in talks to follow.

item.title: Alibaba Qwen Open-Sources Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B for Autonomous Driving Perception and Planning
item.description: Qwen has released Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B, an Apache 2.0 autonomous-driving vision-language model on a Qwen3.5-4B base with 3D perception and trajectory planning. SFT and RL Planning Expert variants are available on Hugging Face and GitHub.

item.title: CXMT Begins Mass Production of LPDDR6 Mobile DRAM With 16Gb Dies and 12,800Mbps Peak
item.description: ChangXin Memory Technologies has started mass production of JEDEC LPDDR6, with 16Gb dies, packages up to 16GB and a 12,800Mbps peak rate. The company cites about 60% more peak bandwidth and 20% lower power versus LPDDR5X.

item.title: MikroTik Patches Critical Flaws Chained to Hack Routers
item.description: Dubbed MikroTrick, the bugs allow attackers to bypass authentication, overwrite configuration files, and take over devices. The post MikroTik Patches Critical Flaws Chained to Hack Routers appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.description: Hackers stole the information of students, teachers, staff, and parents/guardians from a self-hosted Metabase instance. The post Mathspace Data Breach Exposes Over 1 Million People appeared first on SecurityWeek.
